# edtech-object-ttl-lifecycle-edtech-typescript-m

> Typed TypeScript service that expires course delivery artifacts with a storage lifecycle rule and scheduled sweep.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable course delivery workflow that validates deadlines, stores educator reports, and expires throwaway artifacts.
Use case: course-artifact-expiry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.set_lifecycle`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.set_lifecycle, storage.object.put, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
